carried.line: And though they both were occupied with the child she carried
stanza: Well, eventually the boy and the girl get married
Sure enough, they have a son
And though they both were occupied with the child she carried

carried.line: Oh, all of the lives I had carried
stanza: As the lion returned to the family crest
The shepherd took off his sheepskin vest
And the children came pouring and pouring out of my chest
Oh, all of the lives I had carried
Just staggered me, staggered me, staggered me
